learningObjective: See future TD residuals contribute to one advantage estimate with weights that decay by successive powers of gamma lambda.
mediumRationale: A deterministic trajectory SVG can align time steps, residuals, exponential weights, and the right-to-left recursion. Mermaid lacks quantitative weight encoding and an interaction is unnecessary for the first version.

pages.insight: The deck explains that RL samples are dependent trajectories rather than iid examples.
The policy-gradient example computes discounted rewards by iterating backward through an episode, matching GAE's reverse-scan intuition.
